# PanePeek review standards

The paper trail owns project requirements. Apply these rules to changed behaviour; flag source conflicts. Use `.github/instructions/code-review.instructions.md` for investigation and comment style.

## Review rules

- **Product boundary:** Keep the native app macOS 26+ and local-only. Copy/Move follow the transfer-collision rules below, preserving captured identities, batch decisions and affected drafts. Deletion uses Trash without permanent fallback. Flag violations in implemented operations, not missing future tasks. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/0001-product-boundaries.md), [accepted collision policy](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-16-browser-ui-and-preview-improvements.md#confirmation-sheets).
- **Foundation:** Preserve the Swift package/native app foundation and single deployment-target owner. Revisit it through a decision when an integration limitation requires change. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/0004-swift-package-application.md).
- **Navigation:** Resolve directory links to canonical locations off the UI thread; only the latest successful read replaces the location/listing. Keep selected-item link identity for metadata and copied paths. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/0005-finder-directory-symlink-navigation.md).
- **Sorting:** Name keeps folders first; Modified sorts all kinds by actual date, with unknowns last in either direction. Size compares metadata byte counts numerically, initially largest first, with unknown/directory/package/link sizes last in either direction and ascending natural-name/path ties. Preserve selected URLs and pane independence. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-11-modified-sort-policy.md), [Size ordering](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-16-browser-ui-and-preview-improvements.md).
- **Preview and Save:** Keep text reads bounded to 1 MiB/UTF-8, links read-only for editing, drafts intact on rejected transitions/save failures, and conflict checks before atomic replacement. Preserve BOM, newline sequences, owner/group identities and permissions, including executable bits and access-control lists. Ordinary Save carries existing quarantine onto private staging; sandbox Save leaves quarantine to macOS. Keep source checks before publication and never clear quarantine. Unsaved-edit prompts share the adaptive transfer-sheet styling, ordered Cancel, Discard, Save with trailing Mauve Save, Return and Escape. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#details-sidebar-and-preview-editor).
- **Additional previews:** A36–A39 extend the existing Details contract. Render leading closed Markdown front matter as literal YAML-highlighted code, preserving source bytes and draft/undo identity. Markdown links and image descriptions activate only HTTP/HTTPS targets with a host; other targets remain plain text. SVG uses inert image decoding into a static snapshot and source-only Edit, sharing the UTF-8 / 1 MiB limit. Keep external references inactive and bitmap dimensions bounded. PDF is read-only with bounded background loading; retain page/zoom identity and disable form editing, document actions and companion-file opening. Static HTML must install its content policy and resource blocker before loading; disable content JavaScript, automatic remote resources and unintended navigation/local-file access. Only deliberate HTTP/HTTPS links may open outside the viewer. Existing release waivers do not accept these additions. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-20-additional-file-previews.md).
- **Favourites:** Menu-bar opening/removal entries use folder names, adding only enough parent-path context for duplicates, with full paths in help/accessibility and saved order retained. Retain unavailable saved paths and surface navigation errors. The toolbar popover and menu-bar menu must allow explicit removal without opening the path or changing panes/drafts; repeated removal cannot re-add it. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#favourites-and-context-menus).
- **Creation:** Validate the literal filename and create exclusively, including collisions with broken links. Capture the creating pane/directory, guard replaced drafts and refresh affected panes. Successful dot-prefixed creation enables hidden visibility only in the creating pane. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#file-management).
- **Rename:** Keep single-item inline row editing and the shared context/File action. Browser Return begins rename; field Return submits and Escape cancels/restores list focus. Select the basename while retaining editable extensions, and select directory names/extensionless dotfiles whole. Double-click opens inline rename for files/packages/file links and navigates folders/directory links; Command-Down opens directories. A rejected selection must not retarget rename to the old item. Preserve local text-editor keys, collision checks and affected-draft safeguards. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-12-inline-rename-and-browser-keyboard.md), [file activation](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-12-file-double-click-rename.md), [file management](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#file-management).
- **Finder action:** Preserve A18’s four item-menu groups and separators, with Reveal in Finder / Duplicate / Rename first, path copying second, other-pane transfers third and Trash last. Reveal in Finder uses the guarded context selection or focused File-menu selection. Open directories' contents and reveal files/packages/file links using listed URLs; preserve drafts and surface failures. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#favourites-and-context-menus).
- **File information:** A31/A33 provide an initially expanded, accessible metadata disclosure with one saved preference shared across selections, windows and app restarts. Collapse reclaims preview/editor height while preserving document/native editor identity, draft, dirty state, caret/selection, scroll and Undo. Keep the selected absolute path/copy control outside the collapsed section; hidden fields leave keyboard/VoiceOver navigation. Loading and unavailable metadata remain usable on expansion. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#sidebar-details-and-preview-mode).
- **Layout:** T19 retains the active browser/document, restores the hidden browser on the right and rejects new hidden-target transfers. Details permits up to 66% of content width in One Pane and 50% in Two Panes, further bounded by visible browser minimums/dividers. Dragging, keyboard adjustment and Expand share those bounds. Preserve preferred Details width through temporary clamping and mode changes; Restore retains its prior preference. Preview/Edit fills the remaining Details height under A31, retaining a usable minimum and scroll access to metadata/long paths. Flag regressions when this scope is implemented. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-22-single-pane-details-width.md), [Details contract](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#sidebar-details-and-preview-mode).
- **Restoration:** One remembered active-window configuration serves initial launch, Command-Q relaunch and Dock reopening after all browser windows close. Clean launch without a remembered configuration and explicit New Window use One Pane with expanded Details and Home/Home directories. Expansion uses existing A35 bounds and retains compact preferred width for Restore; saved expansion and the unexpanded legacy fallback remain intact. Preserve saved One Pane/Two Panes modes and the two-pane fallback for legacy/invalid mode fields. Explicit New Window stays fresh, including with no windows open; activating an existing/miniaturised window must not arm a later restore. Preserve the record on final close and capture it before successful quit. Persist expanded Details separately from its preferred width so Restore Previous Width survives reopening; legacy/invalid expansion defaults to false. Persist the browser ratio by nominal identity only on deliberate divider drags, retaining it through clamping/order changes. Capture actual native frame changes for the remembered owner, restore once even with delayed native attachment and fit valid frames within current screen-visible bounds; missing/invalid geometry leaves defaults. Unit acceptance does not establish full A27 completion. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-22-single-pane-details-width.md), [A27](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#multiple-windows-and-remembered-directories).
- **Accessibility:** Record affected native/keyboard/VoiceOver and appearance checks; visual approval or native defaults do not establish an app-wide pass. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-11-native-accessibility-baseline.md).
- **Window chrome:** Preserve dragging from title text and empty title-bar background, the configured native double-click action, accepted colours and normal toolbar/traffic-light interaction. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#accepted-ui-design).
- **Browser selection:** Keep Mauve controls and dedicated muted browser highlights, with neutral inactive selection, a contrasting outline and readable selected text. Use public row drawing on the owned native table; retain guarded selection, inline rename and native accessibility. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-12-muted-browser-selection.md).
- **Dark appearance:** Follow system appearance with native Light surfaces; Dark uses Macchiato Base panels/previews, Mantle headers/Details and Crust frame. Mauve-filled enabled controls use Base text in Dark. Preserve native focus/keyboard/accessibility, disabled states and the separate muted browser selection; use public native APIs. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-18-dark-macchiato-surfaces-and-controls.md).
- **Browser file clipboard:** Browser clipboard commands follow native list focus: Copy exports selected file URLs, Paste copies into the receiving directory and Option-Command-V moves there, in one/two-pane mode and across windows/Finder. Reuse transfer guards and captured destinations. Command-Delete trashes the focused browser selection; text/rename fields retain native clipboard/deletion behaviour. Command-X defers a move until Command-V for a matching app-owned clipboard revision. Cancel preserves intent; partial moves retain only unrelocated sources; completion cannot overwrite a newer clipboard. Keep intent session-local and preserve native text Cut/Paste. File-operation Undo/Redo is excluded. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#copy-and-move), [Cut/Paste decision](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-19-browser-file-cut-paste.md).
- **Transfer collisions:** Same-folder copies automatically allocate unused numbered names before the file/package extension, using containing/destination directory identity across aliases, panes and windows. Reserve batch names and revalidate before writing; never overwrite the source or a late winner. Same-item moves remain rejected. Duplicate applies the same copy path to the guarded displayed selection in either layout, preserving clipboard contents and pending Cut intent. Ordinary cross-folder Copy and Move share editable numbered Keep Both, Cancel and explicit regular-file Replace in a horizontal native sheet, ordered Cancel, Replace, Keep Both (omitting Replace when unavailable), with trailing Mauve Keep Both as default. Resolve the entire batch before writes, protect destination drafts, retain recoverable previous destinations and revalidate before publication. No folder/link replacement or merging. Copy retains sources. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-22-same-folder-copies.md), [confirmation sheets](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-16-browser-ui-and-preview-improvements.md#confirmation-sheets).
- **UI refinements:** Preserve [the accepted refinements](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-16-browser-ui-and-preview-improvements.md): Lucide category icons with fallback and an eye-off badge for hidden metadata while retaining the type icon, alignment and accessible Hidden description; joined layout toggle; searchable name/path favourites popover sized for roughly six to eight typical rows; Name / Size / Modified columns with sortable file metadata sizes and no recursive directory totals; browser-local Quick Look; read-only image/video Details with bounded loading and stopped obsolete playback. Move/Trash omit routine confirmation but retain preflight, shared locks and dirty-editor safeguards. Copy/Move name conflicts follow the shared transfer-collision rules above. Resolve known batch conflicts before transfer; never silently overwrite late collisions or merge folders. Success notifications name the file/action (or batch count), have no info/details action and expire after about five seconds; errors/partial results retain accessible details until dismissal. Scope-specific acceptance does not establish unverified app-wide outcomes.
- **App information:** Preserve the Apache-2.0 licence and informational project-origin NOTICE, with third-party notices separate. Keep privacy claims tied to actual app/system behaviour. Public usage examples/screenshots use fictional content and an anonymised demo identity; permit only exact reviewed file/value exceptions in the privacy policy. About uses one app-owned native panel with the shared adaptive floating surface and Mauve links; retain copyable metadata, functional links and browser/draft isolation. About/version/docs work follows the separately approved T21 units. Do not infer distribution or publication approval. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#app-information-and-open-source-documentation).
- **MVP acceptance waivers:** T18 is complete for 1.0.0 (7) with explicit waivers for remaining unverified functional/accessibility/icon checks. Preserve Waived outcomes and their scope; do not infer passing checks or waive CI, privacy, signing, notarisation or package integrity. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-19-mvp-release-acceptance-waivers.md).
- **Intent and evidence:** Meaningful behaviour changes need a current task row and repository evidence, with affected criterion verdicts updated. A PR description alone does not close this gap. Keep progress/results out of specs/plans and unexecuted manual checks pending unless covered by an explicit release-specific waiver. [Sources](../agent-paper-trail/specs/README.md), [workflow](../agent-paper-trail/skills/panepeek-paper-trail/SKILL.md).
- **Paper-trail content:** Keep repository records essential and current. Flag security assessments, vulnerability details, reproduction material, discussion history, approval narration, session-specific details and private paths; these belong in private records. Evidence stays brief: outcome, PR/commit reference and material limits. Flag test narration, execution steps, fixture recipes, obsolete scope, newly added Actions run/job URLs, test totals, case inventories or execution details; run links belong in private review records. Task and criterion rows link evidence without repeating it; decisions retain technical rationale. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/README.md#repository-record-content), [workflow](../agent-paper-trail/skills/panepeek-paper-trail/SKILL.md).
- **Source hygiene:** Keep directory names lowercase except platform-required bundle names. Keep tracking IDs and private paths out of shipped comments; comments explain intent. [Source](../AGENTS.md).
- **Sandbox review:** Preserve the separate review identity/container and explicit folder scope. Require a folder grant before reads, keep access alive through active readers and reject stale permission responses. Persist capability-aware grants and per-directory bookmarks in the review container; verify saved filesystem identity, restore without prompting and retain unavailable locations for reconnection. Favourites retain bookmarks, remain removable when unavailable and reconcile only unchanged saved records after successful navigation. A different reconnection choice must not replace the favourite. Text, image, video and metadata readers retain listing access until completion; text/image loading rejects file links before target reads. Text editing requires a writable containing-folder grant; legacy read-only bookmarks need explicit upgrade. Keep draft/Save access through refresh and cleanup, preserve an unchanged editor and native Undo across listing refresh, and never replace a dirty draft with disk content. Preserve image byte/pixel/thumbnail bounds. Video uses bounded reads from an opened file, rejects secondary URLs and retains access through player teardown and pending reads. Quick Look retains access and opened-file identity through native preview items, follows selection/window ownership and rejects links and unavailable/special items. Keep native file references unbridged so they do not become path snapshots. File operations retain captured source/destination grants through prompts, workers, recovery and refresh. Source mutations need write access; Copy needs source read and destination write access. Reject obsolete permission responses and errors. Clipboard/drop imports preserve native file references and the captured receiving grant. Retain Copy/Cut source access until clipboard replacement or completion, and outgoing drag access through native completion independently of window closure. Source-parent preflight requires read access for Copy and write for Move, with source identity rechecked across permission choices. Finder handoffs retain access and reveal listed links without following targets. Follow shared sandbox distribution for future GitHub and Store releases. Production release packages use the same access model with manual setup, explicit reconnection and persisted grants; automatic preference migration is outside scope. Preserve existing preferences and user files. Gate publication on package validation and a refreshed candidate after all intended app features merge; retain channel-specific signing and submission. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#app-store-sandbox-review).
- **App Store archives:** Require a native single-app archive from shared sources/resources, with non-installable core output and unchanged metadata owners. Keep local manual Store signing/export separate from Developer ID verification; check explicit profile, exact signing identities and approved sandbox capabilities plus profile-bound application/team identifiers. Reject uploads, provisioning changes and automatic build allocation in local preparation. Keep final-candidate, manual acceptance and Store submission gates explicit. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#app-store-archiving-and-signing).
- **Release packaging:** Use the explicit release mode for optimised arm64 bundles in fresh output directories, with version/build-labelled DMG/ZIP downloads and SHA-256 checksums. Preserve the default development build and the existing version/deployment-target owners. Packaging success does not establish signing, notarisation, App Store readiness or publication. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#local-release-packaging).
- **DMG:** Preserve the native app/Applications layout and original Macchiato artwork without GUI automation or global Finder preference changes. Verify the read-only mounted volume, exact shortcut, unchanged app and layout; sign/notarise/staple the image separately and withhold outputs on failed checks. Preserve ZIP as an alternative and keep manual/hosted/browser gates explicit. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#dmg-packaging).
- **Review signing:** Allow an explicit exact Apple Development or Developer ID Application certificate for the isolated review build. Validate before building; verify the selected Apple-issued certificate, bundle seal and exact sandbox capabilities. Keep local signing without a secure timestamp or notarisation, retain ad hoc mode when no identity is selected and fail on a rejected selected identity. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-22-stable-review-signing.md).
- **Developer ID signing:** Require explicit release mode and a valid exact Developer ID Application identity for distribution. Sign the complete bundle with Hardened Runtime and a secure timestamp before archiving; fail closed on seal/certificate/runtime/timestamp or entitlement verification failure. Require exactly the approved App Sandbox, user-selected read/write, app-scoped bookmark and WebKit network-client entitlements; reject additional entitlements and runtime exceptions. Preserve unsandboxed development mode, ad hoc sandbox review packages and existing metadata. Signing success does not establish notarisation or public installation acceptance. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#developer-id-signing-and-hardened-runtime).
- **Notarisation:** Require explicit signed-release mode and a Keychain profile. Match Accepted service results and a clean log to the saved upload/code hashes and arm64 ticket; staple, validate and reverify before final ZIP/checksum/workflow outputs. Resume saved submissions and reject stale or overlapping jobs. Keep credentials and raw service records out of Git. Notarisation does not establish browser installation, publication or App Store acceptance. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#notarisation-and-stapling).
- **Hosted release credentials:** Confine signing/notarisation credentials to the manual main-only release job and its protected environment. Use a job-owned temporary Keychain, explicit notary Keychain lookup and redacted failures; remove credentials before workflow outputs and retry cleanup on interruption. Keep PR CI secret-free and uploads limited to the verified DMG, ZIP, their checksums and app notes. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#hosted-signing-and-notarisation).
- **Release numbering:** Allocate a build only through explicit preparation; ordinary builds retain version/build and version changes require explicit selection. Validate before atomic metadata replacement, exclude overlapping writers to the same file and retain consumed numbers after later build failures. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#release-preparation).
- **GitHub release preparation:** Keep manual preparation read-only, require an exact main commit with both existing workflows passing, and reuse assigned metadata. Keep notes focused on app changes and release metadata, with operational status/checklists in contributor instructions. Upload only review assets; tags, releases and public distribution retain separate gates. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/specs/001-mvp/spec.md#github-release-preparation).
- **CI:** Preserve the stable required check, full PR test/build coverage and secret-free read-only jobs. Hosted success and verified live merge rules are separate from local checks; CI does not replace manual acceptance. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-17-ci-and-merge-checks.md).

- **WebKit sandbox capability:** Permit the network-client entitlement needed for local SVG/HTML rendering, while enforcing offline preview resources through the inert SVG image context and HTML's preinstalled content policy/blocker. This grants OS-level outgoing permission; it does not authorise new networking features or weaker preview policies. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-20-webkit-sandbox-capability.md).
- **HTML local assets:** Serve only bounded regular CSS/image/font files from the HTML file's folder and subfolders through an app-owned scheme. Retain the opened directory and folder grant through reads; reject symbolic links and path escape. Preserve CSS-relative URLs and data resources without giving WebKit filesystem access. Keep scripts and remote requests blocked. [Source](../agent-paper-trail/decisions/2026-10-20-html-local-assets.md).
